==Introduction==

This guide will help you understand how one would properly connect to, and use, the darknet.

+Choosing a network+

There are multiple different networks that could considered part of the 'darknet'. The two most popular being Tor and I2P. This guide will discuss Tor though there are plans to add information regarding I2P in the future.

==Tor==

+Installation+

a better option is to use the Tails operating system, look below

Your best option to use Tor on a computer without changing the operating system would be to install the Tor Browser Bundle. Just follow the prompts to install, it is very straight forward. This, in conjunction with a VPN, is quite secure, though there is still a risk for information to be stored on the host computer.

**+Tails+

Running Tails is a much better option for accessing the Tor network. Tails is a 'live' operating system, it lives on a flash-drive and only ever runs on the computer's RAM, which is wiped clean once the computer is powered off. A computer can run Tails with no effect done to the currently installed operating system. To use Tails you will need an empty flash drive with approx. 4gb of space. Make sure to backup any important files as this drive will be whipped clean during this setup.

Nerdy facts: Tails is based on Debian and has GNOME 3 installed.

Steps:

0: Choose your flash-drive and plug it into your computer.

1: Download a copy of the latest Tails ISO.

2: Download a copy of Universal USB Installer from Pendrive Linux

3: Run Universal USB Installer, follow these directions. and click 'yes' on any prompts.

4: After Installation is complete, close Universal USB Installer and eject the flash-drive you just installed onto and remove it.

5: Choose the computer you would like to use, turn it off and plug your flash-drive with Tails installed into it.

6: Boot into the USB flash-drive. This step varies from computer to computer so your best option would be to search for "Change boot device on [enter computer/motherboard model here]".

That's it, you're using Tails now! Tails is without a doubt the best option for accessing the Tor network.
